1879097208.name: Snake-speech
1879097208.desc: Summons a little snake-friend to brighten your day.

1879112824.name: Call to Arms: Archer
1879112824.desc: You enlist an Archer to assist you in battle.

1879131128.name: Mighty Blow
1879131128.desc: A mighty blow that is difficult to avoid and deals damage over time.

1879136248.name: Quitters Never Win
1879136248.desc: You rouse your allies with a harsh cry, provoking them into fighting longer.

1879198328.name: Friend of Small Hunters (Mountain Lynx)
1879198328.desc: Summons a lynx companion.\n\nThe lynx is a stealthy hunter.

1879208440.name: Treasure Laden Goat
1879208440.desc: A goat laden with the spoils of a treasure hunt!

1879214584.name: Reversal
1879214584.desc: An attack which removes one corruption from the enemy.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879219448.name: Improved Sustaining Bolt
1879219448.desc: The appropriate words may lessen the strain of exertion, enabling a Rune-keeper to sustain their powers for a longer time.  Grants bonus Power if at 9 Battle Attunement.

1879234296.name: Searing Blood Arrow
1879234296.desc: A damaging shot that also restores the Hunter's Morale.\n\nArrows inflict fire damage.

conditionalEffects.description: Ranged Focus Spenders increase your Ranged Damage until your next Ranged Focus Builder.
Blood Arrow heals +5% of Max Morale over time.
Blood Arrow heals +10% of Max Morale over time.

1879238520.name: Feign Injury
1879238520.desc: You fake an injury just long enough to divert the enemy's attention elsewhere.

1879240696.name: Discipline: Red Dawn
1879240696.desc:
<rgb=#66fff>Mounted Discipline</rgb>

Mounted Disciplines are used to alter the attitude and tactics used by your War-steed in Mounted Combat.

<rgb=#66ffff>Red Dawn</rgb>

The Red Dawn Discipline turns your focus to that of the relentless warrior. Damage is improved and your focus is only to force your enemies to yield on the field of battle.

1879248376.name: Kill Shot - Fire
1879248376.desc: Targeting the most vital areas of an opponent is difficult enough. While mounted it takes increased skill and effort; maybe even a little patience and luck, but when you strike with this skill the results are destructive.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>This skill has a reduced chance to hit unless the trait Shoot to Kill is active.</rgb>

1879252600.name: Mearas-lore
1879252600.desc: One with nature and the elements the Mearas are adepts at using the natural world against their enemies; as students of nature, beasts and hidden lore so too are Lore-masters who study these wild horses.

1879272824.name: Sure Strike
1879272824.desc: An attack that cannot be blocked or parried.

conditionalEffects.description: Critical Events Increase your Melee Damage by 3%.
Critical Events Increase your Melee Damage by 6%.

1879274104.name: Snap Shot - Wages of Fear - Light
1879274104.desc: Turning your back on a Warden with javelin at hand is likely to be the last thing you do.\n\nThis skill deals extra damage when used from behind.

1879302520.name: Incite Foe
1879302520.desc: You provoke your enemy, forcing them to take notice and attack you.

1879318136.name: Thrash - Tier 1
1879318136.desc: You maul the enemy with your sharp claws. Subsequent attacks deal more damage.

conditionalEffects.description: Each hit of Thrash increases the damage of the Beorning, stacking up to three times.

procEffects.description: Bestial Fury: \n Whenever you Critically Hit with skills you gain:
DNT - parrying an Attack builds threat.  Evading an Attack builds Wrath.
Vexation: \n Upon taking damage in Man form (20% chance in bear form):
Evading an attack applies an Incoming Healing bonus to you. This can only trigger once every 12 seconds.
DNT - parrying an Attack builds threat.  Evading an Attack builds Wrath.

1879319928.name: Positive Thinking
1879319928.desc: Increases the rider's Morale regen in and out of combat while active.

1879320184.name: Counterattack (Dual)
1879320184.desc: While under the effect of Counter, evading an attack allows you to freely strike your target.

1879396856.name: Return to Estolad Lân
1879396856.desc: Thanks to your friendship with the White Company, you're able to quickly return to Estolad Lân. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879409272.name: Call Dwarves
1879409272.desc: Blow the horn to summon Ausma and Hórin to your side.

1879418744.name: Facepaint - Sword
1879418744.desc: Apply facepaint to your cheek with a sword pattern.

1879463032.name: Tawny Aurochs
1879463032.desc: Summons a tawny aurochs to accompany you on your journeys.

1879467256.name: Flèche
1879467256.desc:
Commit your momentum to a massive lunge, cutting across multiple targets as you dash forward with an increased chance to critically hit.

<rgb=#FF7700>Swordplay Finisher:
 Enables Re-centre.</rgb>

1879470584.name: Quick Strike
1879470584.desc: A quick strike which reduces your foe's fighting prowess.

1879487480.name: Dismiss Pet
1879487480.desc: Dismiss your current companion back to the wilds.

1879497720.name: Major Pet Command
1879497720.desc: Command your pet to execute a major skill on themselves or their target.

1879506552.name: Accursed Knowledge
1879506552.desc: Weaken your enemies with fell knoweldge.\nAfflicted targets deal less damage.

1879506680.name: Will of the Strong
1879506680.desc: Rally and energize your allies while wounding your enemy.

procEffects.description: DNT - Grants the Burglar a crit response effect

1879520632.name: Ginger Mûrai Herding Dog
1879520632.desc: Summons a hard working herding dog to accompany you on your travels.

1879523192.name: The Effigy of The Woe of Khand
1879523192.desc: Summon an effigy of The Woe of Khand, doomed to die shortly after it appears.

1879528568.name: Acid Synergy
1879528568.desc: Devoted to Acid, infused by a Synergy, your target erupts in acidic fury, damaging nearby enemies and afflicting them with an effect corresponding to the devotion of your most recent attack.
